newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint hits all-time low vs soaring dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint hits all-time low vs soaring dollar.

text.p: The Hungarian forint fell to a record low against the dollar on Tuesday on Budapest's interbank forex market as dollar/mark continued to soar in Europe.
The Hungarian unit ended at 177.05/10 to the U.S. unit, compared to an opening of 176.60/65 and a midday level of 176.87/92, dealers said.

"The market was very quiet today," said Balazs Benczedi of West LB Hungaria. "I think the banks are afraid of the U.S. market. They may be awaiting some verbal intervention to slow the dollar (rise)."
